message:
feat(i18n): make English the primary language of the site

- app now defaults to English; only an explicit /ru/... path forces Russian
- root item pages are now English (canonical); Russian mirror moved to
  /ru/item/<slug>/, and the Russian landing page to /ru/
- hreflang alternates and x-default updated accordingly (x-default -> English)
- index.html: lang=en plus English title, description, keywords and OG tags
- item-page share/link URLs respect the active language
- 330 English pages at the root + 330 Russian under /ru/
author: BSS Index Developer
